{"sample_id":"arvo_13359",
 "fine_trace":[
   {"step":1,"file":"fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
    "line":100,"var":"data","code":"idn2_to_ascii_4i((uint32_t *) data, size / 4, out2, 0)",
    "role":"source",
    "note":"Input bytes interpreted as uint32_t array of code points forming domain with xn-- label"},
   {"step":2,"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46",
    "line":222,"var":"ace","code":"ace = u32_to_u8 (s + 4, e - s - 4, NULL, &ace_len)",
    "role":"intermediate",
    "note":"Content after xn-- prefix converted to UTF-8 for punycode decode; contains trailing delimiter"},
   {"step":3,"file":"lib/puny_decode.c","function":"_idn2_punycode_decode",
    "line":157,"var":"b","code":"if (b > max_out) return punycode_big_output",
    "role":"root_cause",
    "note":"Off-by-one: check uses > instead of >= allowing b == max_out, so max_out basic chars are copied filling output buffer completely"},
   {"step":4,"file":"lib/puny_decode.c","function":"_idn2_punycode_decode",
    "line":161,"var":"output","code":"output[out++] = input[j]",
    "role":"sink",
    "note":"Heap-buffer-overflow: copies b == max_out basic chars to output array of max_out elements, then main decode loop processes delimiter as encoded digit causing additional write"}
 ],
 "vuln_logic":{
   "source":{"file":"fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
     "line":100,"operands":["(uint32_t *) data","size / 4"]},
   "root_cause":{"file":"lib/puny_decode.c","function":"_idn2_punycode_decode",
     "line":157,"operands":["b","max_out"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"b","right":"max_out"}},
   "sink":{"file":"lib/puny_decode.c","function":"_idn2_punycode_decode",
     "line":161,"operands":["out","max_out"],
     "relation":{"op":"lt","left":"out","right":"max_out"}},
   "propagation":[
     {"from":{"file":"fuzz/libidn2_to_ascii_8z_fuzzer.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput",
       "line":100,"operands":["data"]},
      "to":{"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46",
       "line":222,"operands":["ace"]},
      "type":"data","via":["input_u32","input_u8","domain_u32","s + 4"],
      "relation":{"op":"eq","left":"ace","right":"u32_to_u8(s + 4, e - s - 4)"}},
     {"from":{"file":"lib/lookup.c","function":"_tr46",
       "line":222,"operands":["ace","ace_len"]},
      "to":{"file":"lib/puny_decode.c","function":"_idn2_punycode_decode",
       "line":161,"operands":["output","out"]},
      "type":"data","via":["input","input_length"],
      "relation":{"op":"ge","left":"b","right":"max_out"}}
   ]
 }}
